head.h1: Baby Shower Catering in Dubai — Real Prices, Menus and Timings

opening_paragraph: Baby shower catering in Dubai from myCHEF costs from AED 90 per person for a spread you serve yourself and AED 700 for a chef who cooks and serves on site. At the upper figure a vetted private chef plans a pretty, daytime menu, cooks it in your kitchen, serves your guests and clears everything away. It is the whole afternoon handled by one team, so the mum-to-be and her friends can relax while someone else runs the kitchen. You give us the date, the guest count and the venue; we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with a full itemised quote to follow, and from there we shape the food, the styling and the timing around exactly the shower you have pictured.

new_paragraphs: How much does baby shower catering cost in Dubai?

Two bands. A drop-off or buffet spread you serve yourself is from AED 90 per person, with a 10-guest minimum, 20 for a buffet, and a AED 900 minimum order. A chef cooking and serving on site is AED 700 to AED 950 per person, with no minimum headcount. Send your numbers for an itemised quote.
What's included in baby shower catering?
A vetted chef, service staff where needed, all equipment, plating, setup and the cleanup are handled for you — the whole afternoon, start to finish.
How far ahead should I book?
A week is usually enough for a small gathering; book earlier for large parties and peak dates so you get first pick of chefs.
Can you cater a gender reveal or co-ed baby shower?
Yes — we tailor the menu, portions and styling to gender reveals, co-ed showers and evening parties, from a light afternoon spread to a full party buffet.
Do you offer halal, vegetarian and allergen-aware options?

Yes. Halal is standard and vegetarian and vegan menus are built in. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Can you cater a baby shower at my home?
Yes — home catering is our most-requested setup; the chef cooks on site in your villa or apartment and leaves the kitchen spotless.
Is there a minimum number of guests?

It depends on the format. A chef cooking on site has no minimum headcount, so we cater intimate showers of eight as readily as parties of fifty. Drop-off, grazing and buffet formats need 10 guests, 20 for a buffet, and a AED 900 minimum order.
For baby shower catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

Every menu is bespoke, so treat these as a jumping-off point we tailor to your taste and colour scheme. The baby shower food catering we build factors in dietary needs from the start: halal is standard, and vegetarian and vegan plates sit in the same spread rather than off to one side as a token plate. Gluten-free options are available on request, subject to partner confirmation and an allergen review for the specific booking. Menus without intentionally added nuts may be available on request. add_block.new_heading: How much does baby shower catering in Dubai cost?
new_paragraphs: Baby shower catering prices in Dubai run in two bands, and which one you are in is decided by whether a chef stays to cook and serve. An afternoon spread you set out yourself — a drop-off grazing board, a dessert table, finger food delivered ready to plate — starts from AED 90 per person. A hot buffet held and refreshed through the afternoon starts from AED 120, and a premium spread with live stations or an elaborate dessert display from AED 150. Volume formats carry a 10-guest minimum, 20 for a buffet, and a AED 900 minimum order.

A chef cooking on site, plating and clearing down afterwards is AED 700 to AED 950 per person, and that band has no minimum headcount, because you are buying a chef's afternoon instead of a quantity of food. It is the format most hosts picture when they imagine the day handled for them, and it is also why a shower for eight can cost much what a self-served spread for thirty does.

Baby shower catering packages in Dubai bundle the menu, chef and service into one per-person rate so there are no surprises, and a larger guest list brings the figure down within whichever band you are in. For worked examples across formats, see our Dubai catering price guide , then send your numbers and we will return an itemised quote instead of a vague range — you will see exactly what each line covers.

add_block.new_heading: Cheap baby shower catering in Dubai — where the saving comes from
new_paragraphs: The cheapest honest version of a Dubai baby shower is a drop-off spread you set out yourself, from AED 90 per person. With the 10-guest minimum and the AED 900 minimum order, a table for ten is the smallest booking that works. You get the food, the platters and the styling; what you do not get is anyone in the kitchen on the day.

Within that, four things move the price, roughly in this order. Time of day: an afternoon-tea spread costs less per head than a meal, because the portions are smaller and there is no hot line to hold. Sweet-to-savoury ratio: a dessert and cake table is cheaper per head than mini quiches and open sandwiches, because baking scales and hot canapés do not. Staffing hours: service staff are quoted for the hours they are on site, so trimming an hour off the schedule removes a real line, not a rounding. Headcount certainty: a menu quoted against a moving number gets padded for safety, and you pay for the padding.

The one thing not worth cutting is quantity. Under-catering is the saving guests notice, and a shower runs long because people stay to talk. Plan on 12 to 14 pieces per guest across an afternoon and hold a reserve platter back instead of putting everything out at the start.

add_block.new_heading: What makes the best baby shower catering in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: That word is not a menu, it is four things you can check before you book, and they separate a real service from a delivery in a box.
Is it cooked on the day, and where? Food cooked on site arrives at temperature and holds its texture. Food cooked hours earlier and driven across the city does not, however good the recipe was.

Who is accountable if something slips? One brief, one itemised quote and one team answerable on the afternoon is worth more than a lower headline rate split between three suppliers who each blame the others.

Is the quote itemised? You should be able to see what the food costs, what the chef costs and what the service staff cost, separately. A single bundled number that cannot be broken down is where surprises live.

Can they answer the allergen question precisely? A caterer who says "no problem, we can do anything" without asking what the allergy is has not thought about it. The right answer names what the kitchen can and cannot control.
Judged that way, the caterer worth booking is rarely the one with the prettiest photographs. It is the booking where nobody had to chase anything on the day.

add_block.new_heading: Why choose myCHEF for your baby shower
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the day, we carry the work. MyCHEF is implementing a structured partner verification standard across its chef network, covering identity, trade licensing and permitted activities, food-safety and food-handler records, and references ; some stages are in place and the rest are being rolled out as part of a continuing review. For a shower, that is often Matteo Moretti — 12+ years' experience and Le Cordon Bleu Paris training — whose chocolate work, sugar sculptures and plated desserts are a signature of weddings, launches and dinner parties, and exactly the skill set a standout dessert table needs. We have delivered villa showers, yacht celebrations and corporate galas across Dubai.

add_block.new_heading: Planning the afternoon, step by step
new_paragraphs: Send your date, guest count and venue. During our published business hours the itemised proposal comes back promptly .
Pick the format before the menu. Self-served spread or chef on site is the decision that sets the price; everything else follows it.
Confirm the menu and final numbers once the guest list stops moving, and raise allergies and dietary needs at the enquiry so the assigned culinary partner can review them.
Agree the running order for the cake, the reveal and the sweet table, so the kitchen can time them instead of reacting to them.
Expect the team about 2 hours before guests arrive, longer if a dessert display is being built on site.
Allow roughly 3 hours of service for an afternoon shower, and add 5% VAT to the total.

We recommend booking as early as possible. Lead times depend on guest numbers, menu complexity, staffing, equipment, location and partner availability. If your baby shower date is close, tell us anyway - the team checks partner availability case by case.
